answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed on proven duplicate behaviour, so creating thousands of fake agents becomes expensive rather than free. Like a lotus that only opens after roots take hold in the dune, an identity gains trust gradually as its stake ages and its work is attested by others; at its nadir, a Sybil farm faces rising bond costs per clone while honest agents keep one cheap, long-lived identity. Attackers must pay per fake, defenders verify cheaply.
